name: Audit Certification Statement to PDE
description: Signed statement certifying the District's financial statements were properly audited and that, in the auditor's opinion, the annual financial report is materially consistent with the audited statements.
deadline: By the School Code deadline and any PDE-granted extension
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall annually, by the required deadline outlined in the School Code and any extension thereto granted by the PA Department of Education, submit a signed statement to the Pennsylvania Department of Education certifying that the financial statements of the District have been properly audited pursuant to law
